title: Shape mutation leg is vacuous against the actual draw path: reverting draw_tie_mark to a solid ring passes CI
detail: The test pins only the tie_dash_on predicate and constants. Replacing draw_tie_mark's dashed loop with the old solid DrawCircleLinesV loop (leaving tie_dash_on intact) fails no test, so the guarded shape can be deleted silently.
recommended_fix: Pin the draw path itself (e.g. count drawn segments via a pure segment-enumeration proc that draw_tie_mark consumes), so removing the dash modulation from draw_tie_mark breaks the count assertion.

title: derive_a11y_palettes.py can no longer regenerate the shipped modes tables from data/palette.json
evidence:
(Side note: the derive script chokes on the
`//` comments now present in palette.json — I ran it on a comment-stripped
copy; pre-existing, out of scope.)
detail: Spec says the derive script "owns the modes output"; after this change the shipped tables are only reproducible via a hand-stripped copy, weakening the data-provenance chain the spec establishes.
recommended_fix: File a follow-up to make derive_a11y_palettes.py strip // comments (or switch palette.json to JSONC-tolerant parsing) so regeneration works on the repo file.
